scores.label: A
scores.note: Option 1 'worse' is a comparative with no comparison, so the meaning changes. Option 3 'detrimental' sounds odd after 'something' (it normally takes 'to …'), so it is too stiff here. Option 6 'critical' takes the sense 'crucial/important', not 'bad'. Option 8 'disastrous' makes the event much stronger than the original. The best pick, 'serious', is at position 2 behind a 0.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Only option 1 'serious' was judged, and it is a strong fit. The other 9 options are duplicates (fail), so the list gives no real choice.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Options 1 'happens' and 2 'occurs' replace the verb instead of 'bad', which gives 'something happens happens', so both are ungrammatical in place. The rest are duplicates (fail).

scores.label: D
scores.note: Option 6 'critical' takes the sense 'crucial/important', not 'bad'. The best pick, 'serious', comes first and 'dangerous' fits the emergency context. The rest are usable but plain or slightly stiff after 'something'.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Option 8 'difficult' gives an odd meaning ('something difficult happens' does not mean an emergency). Option 9 'critical' takes the sense 'crucial/important'. The best pick, 'serious', is buried at position 5. Options 6, 7 and 10 are duplicates or echo 'bad' (fail).
